notes.list_status: Post-deadline, but the town has not re-worded the page: it still reads 'The Municipal Clerk will provide a certified list of candidates following the close of nominations on August 21, 2026.' The names are the current published list.
notes.source_note: The /voters#candidates section is an index of buttons rather than a list; each race links to its own page under /voters/offices-to-be-elected-*, and those seven pages were fetched. They hold the names in a table whose first column is 'Name'.
notes.withdrawals: Six nominations carry a '- Withdrawn' suffix and are excluded here: Sajid Raza Rehman for mayor; Sadiq Boodoo and Angie Papas as Ward 1 local councillor; and Asad Ali, Sajid Dogar and Asif Kasim as Ward 2 local councillor. Two of them moved rather than left: Asad Ali is a Ward 2 regional councillor candidate and Angie Papas a Ward 3 regional councillor candidate.
notes.name_change: Ward 1's regional candidate collected on 2026-08-11 as 'Rob Tyler Morin' is now published as 'Rob Tyler-Morin'.
